info.name: QAssure — Supplier Service
info.description:
API collection for QAssure Supplier Quality Management Service.

Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api/v1

Auth: Bearer JWT Token (auto-populated by Login request)

Folders included:
- Auth: Login endpoint to capture and store jwt_token collection variable
- Lookups: Static reference data (types, categories, statuses, audit types)
- Supplier CRUD: Create, read, update, and list suppliers
- Workflow: Submit for qualification workflow and status patch
- Contacts: Adding and fetching supplier contacts
- Audits: Creating, listing, and completing supplier audits
- Scorecards: Creating and fetching performance scorecards
- ASL: Approved Supplier List management
- Dashboard: Real-time quality dashboard metrics

exec: console.log('✅ Token saved to collection variable');
console.log('✅ Token saved to collection variable (alt field)');

request.description: Create a new supplier. Auto-generates supplier_code (SUP-XXXXX) if not provided. Status defaults to 'pending'. Saves supplier_id to collection variable.
List all suppliers with optional filters: status, category, supplier_type, risk_level, search term. Supports pagination via limit and offset.
Retrieve full supplier details including contacts array, latest scorecard, address, certifications, and audit dates.
Update supplier profile fields. Only allowed fields are updated; others are ignored. Writes audit log entry.
Submits a pending supplier to trigger the supplier_approval workflow. Status transitions from 'pending' to 'qualified'. Stores workflow_instance_id.

Manually update supplier lifecycle status. Valid values: pending, qualified, approved, conditional, suspended, disqualified. When set to 'approved', auto-sets approved_date and expiry_date (+1 year). Triggers notification to quality managers.
Fetch all contacts for a supplier, ordered by is_primary DESC, then name alphabetically.

request.description: Create a performance scorecard for a period. Auto-calculates overall_score using weighted formula: (quality×0.4 + delivery×0.3 + service×0.2 + cost×0.1). Assigns grade A-F. Updates supplier's current_score and score_grade.
